scenes.problem: Three quarters of 24 learners joined the maths club. How many joined?
rows: Name the original unit (learners) and identify the two amounts: 3/4 and 24.
Select 3/4 of 24; divide the whole into equal parts and count the selected groups.
Calculate 3/4 × 24 = 18; give the result in learners and simplify.
scenes.memo: Check the original learners situation: 3/4 × 24 = 18 learners. Confirm by a reverse operation or recombining the parts.
scenes.misconception: Do not lose track of the whole or its unit. Match piece sizes before counting and include partial groups.
